import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_common_port(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080"), 8080)

    def test_leading_zeros_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00000000000000001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0065535"), 65535)

    def test_surrounding_spaces_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 443 "), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   22"), 22)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80   "), 80)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("42")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejects(self, value):
        with self.subTest(value=value):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_is_below_range(self):
        self.assertRejects("0")
        self.assertRejects("00000")

    def test_just_above_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertRejects("65536")
        self.assertRejects("0065536")

    def test_large_values_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("99999")
        self.assertRejects("1" + "0" * 30)

    def test_signs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("+80")
        self.assertRejects("-1")
        self.assertRejects(" -80 ")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("\t80")
        self.assertRejects("80\t")
        self.assertRejects("80\n")
        self.assertRejects("\n80")
        self.assertRejects("80\r\n")
        self.assertRejects("8\t0")

    def test_decimal_points_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("80.0")
        self.assertRejects(".80")
        self.assertRejects("80.")

    def test_non_ascii_digits_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("٨٠")  # Arabic-Indic digits 8, 0
        self.assertRejects("８０")  # fullwidth digits 8, 0
        self.assertRejects("²")  # superscript two
        self.assertRejects(" 80")  # no-break space before digits

    def test_empty_and_space_only_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("")
        self.assertRejects(" ")
        self.assertRejects("     ")

    def test_non_digit_text_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("http")
        self.assertRejects("80a")
        self.assertRejects("0x50")
        self.assertRejects("1_000")
        self.assertRejects("1 2")

    def test_non_string_inputs_rejected(self):
        for value in (None, 80, 80.0, True, b"80", ["80"], ("80",)):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_port(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)

    def test_rejects_just_outside_boundaries(self):
        for text in ["0", "65536", "99999", "100000"]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_port(text)

    def test_leading_zeros(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00065535"), 65535)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0" * 5000 + "443"), 443)

    def test_leading_zeros_do_not_make_zero_valid(self):
        for text in ["00", "000000"]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_port(text)

    def test_surrounding_spaces(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80 "), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   8080   "), 8080)

        invalid = [

            "¹²",  # superscript digits
            "80 ",  # non-breaking space

        for text in invalid:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_port(text)

        for value in [None, 80, 80.0, b"80", bytearray(b"80"), ["80"], ("80",)]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_port(value)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("443")), int)

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def assert_valid_order(test, nodes, edges, order):
    test.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    for a, b in edges:
        test.assertLess(position[a], position[b], f"edge ({a}, {b}) violated")


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_included(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        assert_valid_order(self, nodes, [], order)

    def test_chain_has_single_valid_order(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(["c", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        assert_valid_order(self, nodes, edges, topological_order(nodes, edges))

    def test_disconnected_components(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "x", "y", "z"]
        edges = [("b", "a"), ("y", "z")]
        assert_valid_order(self, nodes, edges, topological_order(nodes, edges))

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_longer_cycle_with_tail_raises(self):
        nodes = ["s", "a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("s", "a"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("b", "c")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        assert_valid_order(self, nodes, edges, order)

    def test_duplicate_edges_still_detect_cycle(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        nodes_before = list(nodes)
        edges_before = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_tuple_nodes_input_is_accepted(self):
        nodes = ("a", "b")
        edges = (("a", "b"),)
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import copy
import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def assert_valid_order(test, nodes, edges, order):
    test.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
    test.assertEqual(len(order), len(set(order)))
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    for a, b in edges:
        test.assertLess(position[a], position[b], f"edge {a}->{b} violated")


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def check(self, nodes, edges):
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        assert_valid_order(self, nodes, edges, order)
        return order

    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_included(self):
        self.assertEqual(sorted(self.check(["x", "y", "z"], [])), ["x", "y", "z"])

    def test_single_node(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.check(["solo"], []), ["solo"])

    def test_chain_is_ordered(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.check(["c", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        order = self.check(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(order[0], "a")
        self.assertEqual(order[-1], "d")

    def test_isolated_node_mixed_with_edges(self):
        self.check(["iso", "a", "b"], [("a", "b")])

    def test_multiple_roots_and_sinks(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]
        edges = [("a", "c"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "d"), ("c", "e")]
        self.check(nodes, edges)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        self.assertEqual(self.check(nodes, [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("a", "b")]), ["a", "b"])

    def test_duplicate_edges_in_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        self.check(nodes, edges)

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_among_other_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_three_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")])

    def test_cycle_with_acyclic_tail_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "b"), ("c", "d")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_cycle_with_isolated_node_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["iso", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_duplicate_edges_plus_cycle_still_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "iso"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        nodes_before = copy.deepcopy(nodes)
        edges_before = copy.deepcopy(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_returns_new_list(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        self.assertIsNot(order, nodes)

    def test_large_chain(self):
        n = 20000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(str(i), str(i + 1)) for i in range(n - 1)]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import random
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def assert_valid_order(test, order, nodes, edges):
    test.assertEqual(len(order), len(nodes))
    test.assertEqual(set(order), set(nodes))
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    for before, after in edges:
        test.assertLess(position[before], position[after], f"{before} must precede {after}")


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_all_included(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        assert_valid_order(self, order, nodes, [])

    def test_chain(self):
        nodes = ["c", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        assert_valid_order(self, topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_isolated_nodes_mixed_with_edges(self):
        nodes = ["x", "a", "b", "y"]
        edges = [("b", "a")]
        assert_valid_order(self, topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_three_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_alongside_acyclic_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_cycle_disconnected_from_acyclic_part_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "x", "y"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("x", "y"), ("y", "x")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b")]
        assert_valid_order(self, topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_duplicate_edges_with_cycle_still_raise(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("c", "d")]
        nodes_before = list(nodes)
        edges_before = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated_when_cycle_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(edges, [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_long_chain_does_not_hit_recursion_limit(self):
        n = 20000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(str(i), str(i + 1)) for i in range(n - 1)]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes)

    def test_random_dags_produce_valid_orders(self):
        rng = random.Random(1234)
        for _ in range(200):
            n = rng.randint(0, 30)
            nodes = [f"n{i}" for i in range(n)]
            permuted = nodes[:]
            rng.shuffle(permuted)
            rank = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(permuted)}
            edges = []
            for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 3 * n)):
                if n < 2:
                    break
                a, b = rng.sample(nodes, 2)
                if rank[a] > rank[b]:
                    a, b = b, a
                edges.append((a, b))
            assert_valid_order(self, topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assert_valid(self, order, nodes, edges):
        self.assertEqual(len(order), len(nodes))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
        position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
        for before, after in edges:
            self.assertLess(position[before], position[after], (before, after))

    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_included(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        self.assert_valid(order, nodes, [])

    def test_chain(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(["c", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        self.assert_valid(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_isolated_node_mixed_with_edges(self):
        nodes = ["x", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("b", "a")]
        self.assert_valid(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_three_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_among_other_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_cycle_unreachable_from_sources_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["s", "b", "c"], [("b", "c"), ("c", "b")])

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b")]
        self.assert_valid(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_duplicate_edges_on_cycle_still_raise(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "d")]
        nodes_before = copy.deepcopy(nodes)
        edges_before = copy.deepcopy(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_large_chain_does_not_recurse(self):
        n = 50_000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(nodes[i], nodes[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1)]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    def test_mixed_isolated_and_connected_nodes(self):
        nodes = ["lone", "a", "b", "other"]
        edges = [("b", "a")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        assert_valid(self, nodes, edges, order)
        self.assertIn("lone", order)
        self.assertIn("other", order)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_with_other_edges_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_cycle_reachable_from_source_raises(self):
        nodes = ["s", "a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("s", "a"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_cycle_disconnected_from_acyclic_part_raises(self):
        nodes = ["p", "q", "x", "y"]
        edges = [("p", "q"), ("x", "y"), ("y", "x")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        nodes_before = list(nodes)
        edges_before = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated_on_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(edges, [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_accepts_generator_edges(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, ((a, b) for a, b in [("a", "b")]))
        self.assertEqual(order, ["a", "b"])

    def test_random_dags_are_valid(self):
        rng = random.Random(1234)
        for _ in range(200):
            n = rng.randint(1, 30)
            nodes = [f"n{i}" for i in range(n)]
            shuffled = nodes[:]
            rng.shuffle(shuffled)
            rank = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(shuffled)}
            edges = []
            for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 3 * n)):
                a, b = rng.sample(nodes, 2)
                if rank[a] > rank[b]:
                    a, b = b, a
                edges.append((a, b))
            order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
            assert_valid(self, nodes, edges, order)

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_db(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", list(enumerate(names, start=1)))
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_prefix_match_sorted_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_db(["bob", "alice", "albert", "alice"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "al", 10), [(2, "alice"), (4, "alice"), (3, "albert")][::1] and
                         [(2, "alice"), (4, "alice"), (3, "albert")])

    def test_ties_ordered_by_id(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)", [(9, "amy"), (3, "amy"), (5, "amy")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "am", 10), [(3, "amy"), (5, "amy"), (9, "amy")])

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["100%", "100 apples", "1000"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100%")])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a_b", "axb", "a_"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(3, "a_"), (1, "a_b")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a\\b", "ab", "a\\"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(3, "a\\"), (1, "a\\b")])

    def test_wildcards_do_not_match_everything(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "%", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "_", 10), [])

    def test_sql_injection_attempt_is_inert(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "' OR 1=1 --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x'); DROP TABLE users; --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 10)), 2)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_at_least_one(self):
        conn = make_db(["a", "b", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_at_most_100(self):
        conn = make_db([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 1000)), 100)

    def test_limit_within_range_is_used(self):
        conn = make_db([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(20)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 7)), 7)

    def test_bool_limit_rejected(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", False)

    def test_non_int_limit_rejected(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        for bad in ("5", 5.0, None, [5]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "", bad)

    def test_non_str_prefix_rejected(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(conn, None, 5)

    def test_matching_is_ascii_case_insensitive_as_with_like(self):
        conn = make_db(["Alice", "alfred"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "ALI", 10), [(1, "Alice")])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def add(self, rows):
        self.conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", rows)

    def names(self, prefix, limit=10):
        return [name for _, name in search(self.conn, prefix, limit)]

    def test_basic_prefix_match(self):
        self.add([(1, "alice"), (2, "alfred"), (3, "bob")])
        self.assertEqual(self.names("al"), ["alfred", "alice"])

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.add([(1, "100% pure"), (2, "100x"), (3, "1000")])
        self.assertEqual(self.names("100%"), ["100% pure"])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.add([(1, "a_c"), (2, "abc"), (3, "a_")])
        self.assertEqual(self.names("a_"), ["a_", "a_c"])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.add([(1, "a\\b"), (2, "axb"), (3, "a\\")])
        self.assertEqual(self.names("a\\"), ["a\\", "a\\b"])

    def test_backslash_before_percent_is_literal(self):
        self.add([(1, "x\\%y"), (2, "x%y"), (3, "xzy")])
        self.assertEqual(self.names("x\\%"), ["x\\%y"])

    def test_sql_injection_prefix_is_inert(self):
        self.add([(1, "alice"), (2, "bob")])
        self.assertEqual(self.names("' OR 1=1 --"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.names("%"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0], 2)

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        self.add([(1, "bob"), (2, "alice")])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(""), ["alice", "bob"])

    def test_order_is_name_then_id(self):
        self.add([(5, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (9, "al"), (1, "sam")])
        self.assertEqual(
            search(self.conn, "s", 10),
            [(1, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (5, "sam")],
        )

    def test_limit_applied(self):
        self.add([(i, "user%02d" % i) for i in range(1, 6)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "user", 3)), 3)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_minimum_one(self):
        self.add([(1, "a"), (2, "b")])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", -50)), 1)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_maximum_100(self):
        self.add([(i, "n%03d" % i) for i in range(1, 151)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "n", 1000)), 100)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "n", 100)), 100)

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        self.add([(1, "a")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", False)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limit(self):
        self.add([(1, "a")])
        for bad in ("5", 5.0, None, [5]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "", bad)

    def test_rejects_non_string_prefix(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 5)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, b"a", 5)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


ROWS = [
    (1, "Alice"),
    (2, "Alicia"),
    (3, "Al%ce"),
    (4, "Al_ce"),
    (5, "Bob"),
    (6, "A\\b"),
    (7, "Ab"),
    (8, "Dup"),
    (9, "Dup"),
]


def make_db(rows):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", rows)
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = make_db(ROWS)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def test_plain_prefix_matches(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "Ali", 10), [(1, "Alice"), (2, "Alicia")])

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "Al%", 10), [(3, "Al%ce")])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "Al_", 10), [(4, "Al_ce")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "A\\", 10), [(6, "A\\b")])

    def test_lone_wildcards_match_nothing(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "%", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "_", 10), [])

    def test_empty_prefix_returns_all_sorted_by_name_then_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            search(self.conn, "", 100),
            [
                (6, "A\\b"),
                (7, "Ab"),
                (3, "Al%ce"),
                (4, "Al_ce"),
                (1, "Alice"),
                (2, "Alicia"),
                (5, "Bob"),
                (8, "Dup"),
                (9, "Dup"),
            ],
        )

    def test_ties_broken_by_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "Dup", 10), [(8, "Dup"), (9, "Dup")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "Dup", 1), [(8, "Dup")])

    def test_limit_below_range_clamps_to_one(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_above_range_clamps_to_one_hundred(self):
        conn = make_db([(i, f"u{i:03d}") for i in range(150)])
        try:
            self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "u", 1000)), 100)
        finally:
            conn.close()

    def test_bool_limit_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", False)

    def test_non_int_limit_rejected(self):
        for bad in ("5", 1.0, 1.5, None, [5]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "", bad)

    def test_non_str_prefix_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 5)

    def test_sql_injection_is_inert(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "x' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "' OR 1=1 --", 10), [])
        count = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(count, len(ROWS))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_db(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)",
        [(i, n) for i, n in enumerate(names, start=1)],
    )
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def names(self, conn, prefix, limit=10):
        return [name for _, name in search(conn, prefix, limit)]

    def test_plain_prefix_match(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "alan", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "al"), ["alan", "alice"])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        conn = make_db(["b", "a"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, ""), ["a", "b"])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a%b", "axb", "a%"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "a%"), ["a%", "a%b"])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a_c", "abc"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "a_"), ["a_c"])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a\\b", "ab", "a\\"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "a\\"), ["a\\", "a\\b"])

    def test_backslash_before_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["x\\%y", "x%y", "x\\zy"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "x\\%"), ["x\\%y"])

    def test_injection_attempt_is_inert(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "' OR 1=1 --"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "x'; DROP TABLE users; --"), [])
        count = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(count, 2)

    def test_ties_ordered_by_id(self):
        conn = make_db(["same", "same", "same"])
        rows = search(conn, "same", 10)
        self.assertEqual(rows, [(1, "same"), (2, "same"), (3, "same")])

    def test_order_is_name_then_id(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)",
            [(3, "ann"), (1, "ann"), (2, "ano")],
        )
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "an", 10), [(1, "ann"), (3, "ann"), (2, "ano")])

    def test_limit_applies(self):
        conn = make_db(["a1", "a2", "a3"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "a", 2), ["a1", "a2"])

    def test_limit_below_range_clamps_to_one(self):
        conn = make_db(["a1", "a2"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "a", 0), ["a1"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "a", -5), ["a1"])

    def test_limit_above_range_clamps_to_hundred(self):
        conn = make_db([f"n{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "n", 1000)), 100)

    def test_limit_boundaries_accepted(self):
        conn = make_db([f"n{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "n", 1)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "n", 100)), 100)

    def test_bool_limit_rejected(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "a", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "a", False)

    def test_non_integer_limit_rejected(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        for bad in ["5", 5.0, None, [5]]:
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "a", bad)

    def test_non_string_prefix_rejected(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(conn, None, 5)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import csv
import io
import re

_HEADER = ["name", "age"]
_AGE_DIGITS = re.compile(r"[0-9]+")
_MAX_AGE = 130


def read_people(text):
    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text, newline=""), strict=True)
    try:
        header = next(reader, None)
        if header != _HEADER:
            raise ValueError(f"expected header name,age, got {header!r}")

        people = []
        for row in reader:
            line = reader.line_num
            if len(row) != 2:
                raise ValueError(f"line {line}: expected 2 columns, got {len(row)}")
            name, age = row
            if not _AGE_DIGITS.fullmatch(age):
                raise ValueError(f"line {line}: age must contain only ASCII digits, got {age!r}")
            value = int(age)
            if value > _MAX_AGE:
                raise ValueError(f"line {line}: age must be 0..{_MAX_AGE}, got {value}")
            people.append({"name": name, "age": value})
    except csv.Error as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid CSV: {exc}") from exc
    return people

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import read_people  # noqa: E402


class ReadPeopleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parses_rows_in_order_with_int_ages(self):
        text = "name,age\nAda,36\nGrace,45\nAlan,41\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [
                {"name": "Ada", "age": 36},
                {"name": "Grace", "age": 45},
                {"name": "Alan", "age": 41},
            ],
        )

    def test_empty_data_after_header_returns_empty_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\n"), [])
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age"), [])

    def test_quoted_name_may_contain_comma(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"Doe, Jane",30\n'),
            [{"name": "Doe, Jane", "age": 30}],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_may_contain_embedded_newline(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"line one\nline two",7\nBob,8\n'),
            [
                {"name": "line one\nline two", "age": 7},
                {"name": "Bob", "age": 8},
            ],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_may_contain_crlf(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\r\n"a\r\nb",1\r\n'),
            [{"name": "a\r\nb", "age": 1}],
        )

    def test_doubled_quotes_unescape(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"Say ""hi""",5\n'),
            [{"name": 'Say "hi"', "age": 5}],
        )

    def test_crlf_line_endings(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people("name,age\r\nAda,36\r\n"),
            [{"name": "Ada", "age": 36}],
        )

    def test_age_boundaries_are_accepted(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people("name,age\nA,0\nB,130\n"),
            [{"name": "A", "age": 0}, {"name": "B", "age": 130}],
        )

    def test_leading_zeros_are_ascii_digits(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\nA,007\n"), [{"name": "A", "age": 7}])

    def test_age_above_130_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nA,131\n")

    def test_invalid_ages_are_rejected(self):
        bad_ages = [
            "",
            " 3",
            "3 ",
            "+3",
            "-1",
            "3.0",
            "1e2",
            "0x1A",
            "1_0",
            "abc",
            "١٢",  # Arabic-Indic digits 12
            "²",  # superscript two
            "1" * 5000,
        ]
        for age in bad_ages:
            with self.subTest(age=age):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(f"name,age\nA,{age}\n")

    def test_wrong_header_is_rejected(self):
        bad_headers = [
            "",
            "\n",
            "age,name\nA,1\n",
            "Name,Age\nA,1\n",
            "name\nA\n",
            "name,age,city\nA,1,X\n",
            "name,age,\nA,1,\n",
            "id,name,age\n1,A,1\n",
        ]
        for text in bad_headers:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(text)

    def test_missing_column_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAda\n")

    def test_extra_column_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAda,36,extra\n")

    def test_blank_line_is_rejected(self):

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import read_people  # noqa: E402


class ReadPeopleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parses_rows_in_order(self):
        text = "name,age\nAlice,30\nBob,25\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Alice", "age": 30}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 25}],
        )

    def test_header_only_returns_empty_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\n"), [])
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age"), [])

    def test_quoted_name_may_contain_comma(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"Doe, Jane",41\n'
        self.assertEqual(read_people(text), [{"name": "Doe, Jane", "age": 41}])

    def test_quoted_name_may_contain_embedded_newline(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"Line one\nLine two",40\nBob,25\n'
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Line one\nLine two", "age": 40}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 25}],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_may_contain_crlf_newline(self):
        text = 'name,age\r\n"Line one\r\nLine two",40\r\n'
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Line one\r\nLine two", "age": 40}],
        )

    def test_doubled_quotes_are_unescaped(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"He said ""hi""",5\n'
        self.assertEqual(read_people(text), [{"name": 'He said "hi"', "age": 5}])

    def test_age_boundaries(self):
        text = "name,age\nZero,0\nMax,130\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Zero", "age": 0}, {"name": "Max", "age": 130}],
        )

    def test_leading_zeros_are_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\nA,007\n"), [{"name": "A", "age": 7}])

    def test_empty_input_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("")

    def test_wrong_header_raises(self):
        for header in ["age,name", "Name,age", "name,AGE", "name,years", "name", "name;age"]:
            with self.subTest(header=header):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(f"{header}\nAlice,30\n")

    def test_extra_header_column_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age,city\nAlice,30,Paris\n")

    def test_missing_column_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice\n")

    def test_extra_column_in_row_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice,30,Paris\n")

    def test_blank_line_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice,30\n\nBob,25\n")

    def test_unclosed_quote_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Alice,30\n')

    def test_text_after_closing_quote_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Alice"x,30\n')

    def test_invalid_ages_raise(self):
        bad_ages = [
            "",
            " 30",
            "30 ",
            "-1",
            "+5",
            "5.0",
            "1e2",
            "1_0",
            "0x1A",
            "abc",
            "131",
            "99999999999999999999",
            "٣٠",  # Arabic-Indic digits
        ]
        for age in bad_ages:
            with self.subTest(age=age):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(f"name,age\nAlice,{age}\n")

    def test_error_in_later_row_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice,30\nBob,131\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

_TIMESTAMP = re.compile(
    r"""
    (?P<year>[0-9]{4})-(?P<month>[0-9]{2})-(?P<day>[0-9]{2})
    T(?P<hour>[0-9]{2}):(?P<minute>[0-9]{2}):(?P<second>[0-9]{2})
    (?:\.(?P<fraction>[0-9]+))?
    (?P<offset>[Zz]|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})
    """,
    re.VERBOSE | re.ASCII,
)


def utc_day_start(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError("timestamp must be a string")
    match = _TIMESTAMP.fullmatch(text)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid ISO 8601 timestamp with UTC or numeric offset: {text!r}")

    offset_text = match["offset"]
    if offset_text in "Zz":
        offset = timedelta(0)
    else:
        digits = offset_text[1:].replace(":", "")
        offset_hours, offset_minutes = int(digits[:2]), int(digits[2:])
        if offset_minutes > 59:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid UTC offset in timestamp: {text!r}")
        offset = timedelta(hours=offset_hours, minutes=offset_minutes)
        if offset_text[0] == "-":
            offset = -offset

    microsecond = int((match["fraction"] or "0")[:6].ljust(6, "0"))
    try:
        local = datetime(
            int(match["year"]),
            int(match["month"]),
            int(match["day"]),
            int(match["hour"]),
            int(match["minute"]),
            int(match["second"]),
            microsecond,
            tzinfo=timezone(offset),
        )
        instant = local.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    except (OverflowError, ValueError) as error:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid timestamp {text!r}: {error}") from error

    return instant.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import decode_chunks  # noqa: E402


class DecodeChunksTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_iterable(self):
        self.assertEqual(decode_chunks([]), "")

    def test_empty_chunks_are_ignored(self):
        self.assertEqual(decode_chunks([b"", b"ab", b"", b"c", b""]), "abc")

    def test_multibyte_character_split_across_chunks(self):
        # "€" is E2 82 AC; "😀" is F0 9F 98 80
        self.assertEqual(decode_chunks([b"x\xe2\x82", b"\xacy"]), "x€y")
        self.assertEqual(decode_chunks([b"\xf0\x9f", b"\x98", b"\x80"]), "😀")

    def test_every_byte_boundary(self):
        text = "aé€😀z"

import pathlib
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

from solution import decode_chunks  # noqa: E402

TEXT = "aé€😀z"
DATA = TEXT.encode("utf-8")


class DecodeChunksTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_multibyte_char_split_across_chunks(self):
        euro = "€".encode("utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(euro, b"\xe2\x82\xac")
        self.assertEqual(decode_chunks([b"\xe2", b"\x82", b"\xac"]), "€")
        self.assertEqual(decode_chunks([b"x\xe2\x82", b"\xac y"]), "x€ y")

    def test_every_two_way_split(self):
        for i in range(len(DATA) + 1):
            with self.subTest(split=i):
                self.assertEqual(decode_chunks([DATA[:i], DATA[i:]]), TEXT)

    def test_one_byte_per_chunk(self):
        self.assertEqual(decode_chunks(bytes([b]) for b in DATA), TEXT)

    def test_empty_chunks_are_ignored(self):
        self.assertEqual(decode_chunks([b"", b"a", b"", b"\xe2\x82", b"", b"\xac", b""]), "a€")

    def test_empty_iterable(self):
        self.assertEqual(decode_chunks([]), "")
        self.assertEqual(decode_chunks(iter(())), "")

    def test_incomplete_final_character(self):
        with self.assertRaises(UnicodeDecodeError):
            decode_chunks([b"abc\xe2\x82"])
        with self.assertRaises(UnicodeDecodeError):
            decode_chunks([b"abc\xf0\x9f", b"\x98"])

    def test_invalid_utf8_is_rejected(self):
        cases = {
            "lone continuation": b"\x80",
            "invalid start byte": b"\xff",
            "overlong encoding": b"\xc0\xaf",
            "encoded surrogate": b"\xed\xa0\x80",
            "truncated sequence before ascii": b"\xe2A",
        }
        for name, data in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(case=name):
                with self.assertRaises(UnicodeDecodeError):
                    decode_chunks([data])
                with self.assertRaises(UnicodeDecodeError):
                    decode_chunks([data[:1], data[1:]])

    def test_streams_without_reading_past_error(self):
        def chunks():
            yield b"ok\xff"
            raise AssertionError("consumed past invalid chunk")

        with self.assertRaises(UnicodeDecodeError):
            decode_chunks(chunks())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

from solution import resolve_upload  # noqa: E402


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.tmp = Path(self._tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = self.tmp / "root"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling = self.tmp / "root-evil"
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("secret")

    def tearDown(self):
        self._tmp.cleanup()

    def test_nested_nonexistent_target_resolves_inside_root(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")

    def test_nonexistent_target_creates_nothing(self):
        resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(os.listdir(self.root), [])

    def test_existing_file_inside_root_is_accepted(self):
        (self.root / "f.txt").write_text("x")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "f.txt"), self.root / "f.txt")

    def test_absolute_path_is_rejected(self):

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

from solution import resolve_upload


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = base / "root"
        self.sibling = base / "root-sibling"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "link_out")
        os.symlink(self.root, self.root / "link_self")

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_is_inside_root_and_creates_nothing(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/c.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "c.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_existing_file_inside_root(self):
        (self.root / "f.txt").write_text("x")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "f.txt"), self.root / "f.txt")

    def test_absolute_path_inside_root_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.root / "f.txt"))

    def test_absolute_path_outside_root_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "/etc/passwd")

    def test_empty_and_dot_target_equal_to_root_are_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, ".")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "a/..")

    def test_parent_traversal_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../x")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "a/../../x")

    def test_sibling_directory_with_shared_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root-sibling/x")

    def test_symlink_pointing_outside_root_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link_out")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link_out/new.txt")

    def test_dangling_symlink_pointing_outside_root_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "missing.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlink_pointing_back_inside_root_is_allowed(self):
        (self.root / "real").mkdir()
        os.symlink(self.root / "real", self.root / "alias")
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "alias/f.txt"),
            (self.root / "real" / "f.txt").resolve(),
        )

    def test_symlink_to_root_resolves_to_root_contents(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link_self/f.txt"), self.root / "f.txt"
        )
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link_self")

    def test_root_given_as_symlink_is_resolved(self):
        root_alias = self.sibling / "alias_root"
        os.symlink(self.root, root_alias)
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(root_alias, "f.txt"), self.root / "f.txt")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

from solution import resolve_upload  # noqa: E402


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = base / "root"
        self.sibling = base / "root-sibling"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("secret")
        (self.root / "ok.txt").write_text("ok")
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "escape", target_is_directory=True)
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "missing", self.root / "dangling")
        os.symlink(self.root / "ok.txt", self.root / "alias")
        os.symlink(self.root, self.root / "self", target_is_directory=True)

    def test_existing_file_inside_root(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "ok.txt"), self.root / "ok.txt")

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_is_returned_and_not_created(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_dotdot_that_stays_inside_root_is_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "a/../ok.txt"), self.root / "ok.txt")

    def test_absolute_path_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.sibling / "secret.txt"))

    def test_root_itself_is_rejected(self):
        for supplied in (".", "", "sub/..", "self"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_sibling_directory_with_shared_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root-sibling/new.txt")

    def test_deep_traversal_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "a/../../root-sibling/new.txt")

    def test_symlink_pointing_outside_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "escape")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "escape/secret.txt")

    def test_dangling_symlink_pointing_outside_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlink_pointing_inside_is_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "alias"), self.root / "ok.txt")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
